## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* (上 / 下) supplementary doctrinal work to [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ's *Móhē zhǐguān* ([KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130), T1911) by [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán, organised as a sequence of seven *lì* 例 ("cases" / "examples") that elaborate selected doctrinal points of the *Móhē zhǐguān*. The work belongs to Zhànrán's broader project of systematic Tiāntái scholastic consolidation alongside his three great subcommentaries.

**Abstract**

The *Zhǐguān yìlì* is a focused supplementary doctrinal work that addresses seven selected interpretive issues in the *Móhē zhǐguān*, providing systematic Tiāntái scholastic resolution of contested points. The work is consequently more analytically focused than the comprehensive *Zhǐguān fǔxíng* ([KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131)) and was widely used in the Tiāntái scholastic curriculum for systematic doctrinal preparation.

The composition is bracketed within Zhànrán's mature productive period c. 750–782.
